title: RunState
description: Authoritative run state returned to a runtime, run-state/1: the accepted checkpoint (absent for a new run) and the recorded result for its waiting operation when one exists.

recorded.title: RecordedHostResult

resultRef.description: Broker result or executor intent ID that proves this outcome.

result.description: Plain recorded record for read and ai.decide (for example {price, observedAt} or {decision, summary}); typed by the interpreter against the node's declared result.

recorded.description: Recorded result of the waiting operation.

observationRefs.description: Broker result IDs recorded so far in this run, in order; the runtime cites them in ActionIntent.observationRefs.
